passages.text: Hear the word that the LORD speaks to you, O house of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to the house of Israel.
The LORD gives a message to Israel.
House of Israel, listen to this word.
Hear what the LORD says to you.
passages.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by the signs in the heavens, though the nations themselves are terrified by them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Israel.
The LORD gives a command.
Do not learn the ways of the nations.
Do not be terrified by signs in the heavens.
The nations fear these signs.
You must not fear them.
passages.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אַל־ תִּלְמָ֔דוּ וּמֵאֹת֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם אַל־ תֵּחָ֑תּוּ כִּֽי־ יֵחַ֥תּוּ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם מֵהֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: For the customs of the peoples are worthless; they cut down a tree from the forest; it is shaped with a chisel by the hands of a craftsman.
passages.sermon:
The peoples have customs.
These customs are worthless.
People cut down a tree from the forest.
A craftsman shapes the wood with a chisel.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ חֻקּ֥וֹת הָֽעַמִּ֖ים הֶ֣בֶל ה֑וּא כִּֽי־ עֵץ֙ מִיַּ֣עַר כְּרָת֔וֹ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵ֥י־ חָרָ֖שׁ בַּֽמַּעֲצָֽד׃

passages.text: They adorn it with silver and gold and fasten it with hammer and nails, so that it will not totter.
passages.sermon:
People take the idol.
They cover the idol with silver.
They cover the idol with gold.
They use nails to fasten the idol.
They use a hammer to fasten the idol.
They do this so the idol will not fall over.
passages.original: בְּכֶ֥סֶף וּבְזָהָ֖ב יְיַפֵּ֑הוּ בְּמַסְמְר֧וֹת וּבְמַקָּב֛וֹת יְחַזְּק֖וּם וְל֥וֹא יָפִֽיק׃

passages.text: Like scarecrows in a cucumber patch, their idols cannot speak. They must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they can do no harm, and neither can they do any good.”
passages.sermon:
The idols of the nations are like scarecrows in a cucumber field.
These idols cannot speak.
People must carry these idols.
These idols cannot walk.
Do not be afraid of these idols.
These idols cannot harm anyone.
These idols cannot help anyone.
passages.original: כְּתֹ֨מֶר מִקְשָׁ֥ה הֵ֙מָּה֙ וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ נָשׂ֥וֹא יִנָּשׂ֖וּא כִּ֣י לֹ֣א יִצְעָ֑דוּ אַל־ תִּֽירְא֤וּ מֵהֶם֙ כִּי־ לֹ֣א יָרֵ֔עוּ וְגַם־ הֵיטֵ֖יב אֵ֥ין אוֹתָֽם׃ס

passages.text: There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is unique.
No one is like the LORD.
The LORD is great.
The LORD’s name is powerful.
The LORD’s name shows great strength.
passages.original: מֵאֵ֥ין כָּמ֖וֹךָ יְהוָ֑ה גָּד֥וֹל אַתָּ֛ה וְגָד֥וֹל שִׁמְךָ֖ בִּגְבוּרָֽה׃

passages.text: Who would not fear You, O King of nations? This is Your due. For among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like You.
passages.sermon:
God is the King of all nations.
God deserves to be feared and respected.
No one is like God.
No wise person among the nations is like God.
No king in any kingdom is like God.
passages.original: מִ֣י לֹ֤א יִֽרָאֲךָ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם כִּ֥י לְךָ֖ יָאָ֑תָה כִּ֣י בְכָל־ חַכְמֵ֧י הַגּוֹיִ֛ם וּבְכָל־ מַלְכוּתָ֖ם מֵאֵ֥ין כָּמֽוֹךָ׃

passages.text: But they are altogether senseless and foolish, instructed by worthless idols made of wood!
passages.sermon:
They are all senseless.
They act foolishly.
They learn from worthless idols.
These idols are only wood.
passages.original: וּבְאַחַ֖ת יִבְעֲר֣וּ וְיִכְסָ֑לוּ מוּסַ֥ר הֲבָלִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz— the work of a craftsman from the hands of a goldsmith. Their clothes are blue and purple, all fashioned by skilled workers.
passages.sermon:
People bring hammered silver from Tarshish.
They bring gold from Uphaz.
Craftsmen make these things.
Goldsmiths shape them with their hands.
The idols wear clothes of blue and purple.
Skilled workers make all these garments.
passages.original: כֶּ֣סֶף מְרֻקָּ֞ע מִתַּרְשִׁ֣ישׁ יוּבָ֗א וְזָהָב֙ מֵֽאוּפָ֔ז מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חָרָ֖שׁ וִידֵ֣י צוֹרֵ֑ף תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ לְבוּשָׁ֔ם מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֲכָמִ֖ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

passages.text: But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and eternal King. The earth quakes at His wrath, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the true God.
The LORD is alive.
The LORD is King forever.
When the LORD is angry, the earth shakes.
When the LORD is furious, the nations cannot stand.
passages.original: וַֽיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ אֱמֶ֔ת הֽוּא־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים חַיִּ֖ים וּמֶ֣לֶךְ עוֹלָ֑ם מִקִּצְפּוֹ֙ תִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹֽא־ יָכִ֥לוּ גוֹיִ֖ם זַעְמֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Thus you are to tell them: “These gods, who have made neither the heavens nor the earth, will perish from this earth and from under these heavens.”
passages.sermon:
These gods did not make the heavens.
These gods did not make the earth.
Tell the people this truth.
These gods will perish from the earth.
These gods will disappear from under the heavens.
passages.original: כִּדְנָה֙ תֵּאמְר֣וּן לְה֔וֹם אֱלָ֣הַיָּ֔א דִּֽי־ שְׁמַיָּ֥א וְאַרְקָ֖א לָ֣א עֲבַ֑דוּ יֵאבַ֧דוּ מֵֽאַרְעָ֛א וּמִן־ תְּח֥וֹת שְׁמַיָּ֖א אֵֽלֶּה׃ס

passages.text: The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the true God.
The LORD is the living God.
The LORD is the eternal King.
The LORD made the earth by His power.
The LORD established the world by His wisdom.
The LORD stretched out the heavens by His understanding.
passages.original: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּכֹח֔וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּחָכְמָת֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנָת֖וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the one true God.
He made the earth by His power.
He established the world by His wisdom.
He stretched out the heavens by His understanding.
When the LORD thunders, the waters in the heavens roar.
He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth.
He makes lightning for the rain.
He brings out the wind from His storehouses.
passages.original: לְק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜וֹ הֲמ֥וֹן מַ֙יִם֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיַּעֲלֶ֥ה נְשִׂאִ֖ים מִקְצֵ֣ה אֶרֶץ בְּרָקִ֤ים לַמָּטָר֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַיּ֥וֹצֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵאֹצְרֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
passages.sermon:
Every person lacks understanding.
No one has true knowledge.
Every goldsmith feels shame because of his idols.
His idols are false.
These images are a lie.
There is no life in them.
They have no breath.
passages.original: נִבְעַ֤ר כָּל־ אָדָם֙ מִדַּ֔עַת הֹבִ֥ישׁ כָּל־ צוֹרֵ֖ף מִפָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר נִסְכּ֖וֹ וְלֹא־ ר֥וּחַ בָּֽם׃

passages.text: They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.
passages.sermon:
Idols are worthless.
People made these idols to deceive others.
These idols deserve mockery.
God will punish these idols.
When God punishes them, they will perish.
passages.original: הֶ֣בֶל הֵ֔מָּה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּעֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃

passages.text: The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
passages.sermon:
The Portion of Jacob is different from idols.
God is the Portion of Jacob.
God made all things.
Israel belongs to God as His chosen people.
The LORD of Hosts is God’s name.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ כְאֵ֜לֶּה חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲקֹ֗ב כִּֽי־ יוֹצֵ֤ר הַכֹּל֙ ה֔וּא וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֵׁ֖בֶט נַֽחֲלָת֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Gather up your belongings from this land, you who live under siege.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
He tells them to gather their belongings.
He tells them to prepare to leave this land.
The people live under siege.
They must get ready to go.
passages.original: אִסְפִּ֥י מֵאֶ֖רֶץ כִּנְעָתֵ֑ךְ יֹשַׁבְתִּי בַּמָּצֽוֹר׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD is the Maker of all things.
The LORD is the LORD of Hosts.
The LORD says this.
At this time, I will sling out the people who live in this land.
I will bring distress upon them.
I will do this so that they may be captured.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י קוֹלֵ֛עַ אֶת־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ בַּפַּ֣עַם הַזֹּ֑את וַהֲצֵר֥וֹתִי לָהֶ֖ם לְמַ֥עַן יִמְצָֽאוּ׃ס

passages.text: Woe to me because of my brokenness; my wound is grievous! But I said, “This is truly my sickness, and I must bear it.”
passages.sermon:
The speaker is Jeremiah.  
Jeremiah feels deep sorrow.  
He says, "Woe to me because of my brokenness."  
He suffers from a grievous wound.  
He says, "This is truly my sickness."  
He says, "I must bear it."
passages.original: א֥וֹי לִי֙ עַל־ שִׁבְרִ֔י נַחְלָ֖ה מַכָּתִ֑י וַאֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי אַ֛ךְ זֶ֥ה חֳלִ֖י וְאֶשָּׂאֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: My tent is destroyed, and all its ropes are snapped. My sons have departed from me and are no more. I have no one left to pitch my tent or set up my curtains.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is Jeremiah.
Jeremiah is a prophet in Judah.
Jeremiah says his tent is destroyed.
All the ropes of his tent are snapped.
His sons have left him.
His sons are gone.
No one remains to pitch his tent.
No one is left to set up his curtains.
passages.original: אָהֳלִ֣י שֻׁדָּ֔ד וְכָל־ מֵיתָרַ֖י נִתָּ֑קוּ בָּנַ֤י יְצָאֻ֙נִי֙ וְאֵינָ֔ם אֵין־ נֹטֶ֥ה עוֹד֙ אָהֳלִ֔י וּמֵקִ֖ים יְרִיעוֹתָֽי׃

passages.text: For the shepherds have become senseless; they do not seek the LORD. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.
passages.sermon:
The shepherds lead the people of Israel.
These shepherds have become senseless.
They do not seek the LORD.
Because of this, they do not prosper.
All their flock is scattered.
passages.original: כִּ֤י נִבְעֲרוּ֙ הָֽרֹעִ֔ים וְאֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א דָרָ֑שׁוּ עַל־ כֵּן֙ לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּ֔ילוּ וְכָל־ מַרְעִיתָ֖ם נָפֽוֹצָה׃ס

passages.text: Listen! The sound of a report is coming— a great commotion from the land to the north. The cities of Judah will be made a desolation, a haunt for jackals.
passages.sermon:
A message is coming.
You can hear the sound.
There is a great commotion.
This commotion comes from the land to the north.
The cities of Judah will become empty.
No one will live there.
Jackals will live in these ruined cities.
passages.original: ק֤וֹל שְׁמוּעָה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֔ה וְרַ֥עַשׁ גָּד֖וֹל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֑וֹן לָשׂ֞וּם אֶת־ עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה שְׁמָמָ֖ה מְע֥וֹן תַּנִּֽים׃ס

passages.text: I know, O LORD, that a man’s way is not his own; no one who walks directs his own steps.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah is speaking to the LORD.
Jeremiah knows something important about people.
Jeremiah says, “LORD, a man does not control his own way.”
A person cannot direct his own steps.
God is the one who guides people’s paths.
passages.original: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י לֹ֥א לָאָדָ֖ם דַּרְכּ֑וֹ לֹֽא־ לְאִ֣ישׁ הֹלֵ֔ךְ וְהָכִ֖ין אֶֽת־ צַעֲדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Correct me, O LORD, but only with justice— not in Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker asks the LORD to correct him.
The speaker wants correction with justice.
The speaker does not want correction in anger.
The speaker fears that anger would destroy him.
passages.original: יַסְּרֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה אַךְ־ בְּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אַל־ בְּאַפְּךָ֖ פֶּן־ תַּמְעִטֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, and on the families that do not call on Your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have consumed him and finished him off; they have devastated his homeland.
passages.sermon:
God, pour out Your wrath on the nations.
These nations do not know You.
Pour out Your wrath on the families.
These families do not call on Your name.
They have devoured Jacob.
They have consumed Jacob.
They have finished Jacob off.
They have destroyed Jacob’s homeland.
passages.original: שְׁפֹ֣ךְ חֲמָתְךָ֗ עַל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יְדָע֔וּךָ וְעַל֙ מִשְׁפָּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּשִׁמְךָ֖ לֹ֣א קָרָ֑אוּ כִּֽי־ אָכְל֣וּ אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַאֲכָלֻ֙הוּ֙ וַיְכַלֻּ֔הוּ וְאֶת־ נָוֵ֖הוּ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ׃פ
